plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Avaya router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization and capacity, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 6889).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Average CPU utilisation of the Avaya gateway (UTILIZATION-MANAGEMENT-MIB genCpuAverageUtilization, 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.1.11.1.1.1.1.5, 60-second window, 0-100%), averaged across CPU rows. Rows where CPU utilisation monitoring is disabled on the device are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical RAM of the Avaya gateway (UTILIZATION-MANAGEMENT-MIB genMemUtilizationTotalRAM, 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.1.11.1.2.1.0, reported in MB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Dynamically allocated memory in use (UTILIZATION-MANAGEMENT-MIB genMemUtilizationDynAllocMemUsed, 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.1.11.1.2.3.1.0, reported in MB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Dynamically allocated memory still available (UTILIZATION-MANAGEMENT-MIB genMemUtilizationDynAllocMemAvailable, 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.1.11.1.2.3.3.0, reported in MB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation reported by the device (UTILIZATION-MANAGEMENT-MIB genMemUtilizationPercentUsed, 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.1.11.1.2.6.1.3, percent); the highest value across memory rows.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
